comment: Independent options.c:optfn_fruit() witness for a typed Latin-1 byte. Seed 27183041, clock 20570703161522, Priest, the full-menu route and the fruit name were chosen before JavaScript comparison. tty getlin stores the key 0xE9 as one byte; nmcpy() copies it and bones.c sanitize_name() replaces it with '_' because eight_bit_tty is off, so C prints Fruit is now "pomm_".
